name: vertm-ui
description: VertM UI — Traditional Mongolian vertical React component library
author: dorren002

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vertm/tokens && npm run build -w @vertm/core && npm run build -w @vertm/icons && npm run build -w @vertm/react && npm run build -w @vertm/wasm && npm run build -w @vertm/react-demo --if-present
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && npm pack -w @vertm/tokens --dry-run && npm pack -w @vertm/core --dry-run && npm pack -w @vertm/styles --dry-run && npm pack -w @vertm/icons --dry-run && npm pack -w @vertm/wasm --dry-run && npm pack -w @vertm/react --dry-run
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build && npm publish -w @vertm/tokens && npm publish -w @vertm/core && npm publish -w @vertm/styles && npm publish -w @vertm/icons && npm publish -w @vertm/wasm && npm publish -w @vertm/react
